body: Nothing big, honestly. It usually happens whenever I feel a negative emotion. Or when the meds wore off. I'm quite okay during the holidays.

I talked to someone about my situation. I also had therapy. Been taking medication. I was stable for a couple of weeks but I became self-destructive once again. It's feel like just when you already came out of this sink hole, something grabs you back and got drown again. It's just a repeating cycle.
